newsitem.title: UK: London palladium fixes at fresh three-year low.
newsitem.headline: London palladium fixes at fresh three-year low.

text.p: Palladium fixed at a fresh three-year low on Monday, under pressure from sluggish demand and spill-over from collapsing silver prices.
Palladium fixed at $116.75 an ounce, the lowest since September 15, 1993. It had fixed at $118.75 in the morning.
London palladium fixes at fresh three-year low =2
Prices of the rare white metal have been sliding steadily in recent weaks, undermined by steady sales by key producer Russia and slower demand from the Japanese electronics industry.
Additional pressure on the precious metals complex cropped up last week from heavy selling of silver by speculators and U.S. investment funds.
Analysts said palladium was vulnerable to further losses down to the $112-$115 per ounce area since breaking below the key $120 support level last week.
Platinum fixed unchanged from the morning fixing at $386.50 an ounce, which was a fresh low in nearly 2-1/2 years.
